decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: project created day 1, onboarding call held [calendar:d78e4a3a], replied positively with no blockers [email:7cdbef99]. But no invite sent, no key milestone in 6 days, and "still getting used to the layout" suggests slow self-driven progress; 8 days left. No tickets.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Glad to hear it's going well and that the layout is starting to click -- that's normal in the first week.

Since you've got a project up, the next thing that usually helps is getting your team in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add several at once.

Would a short call this week suit, so I can walk you through whichever part is still feeling unfamiliar?

Best,
Priya
